items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I knew Mr. Moten, and he had children of the same age as me and my brother. So we grew up with Moten kids

ctx.x: No, Mr. Moten, who took his place.

Oh, Well, I knew Mr. Moten, and he had children of the same age as me and my brother. So we grew up with Moten kids, the younger Moten children -- there were two older and two younger than me and my brother.
